data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is named 'inherits,' but the body does not establish an inheritance (subtype/structural-continuity) relationship; it asserts a mere conditional dependence — that SRC_005 relies on SRC_003's ownership-based localization because 'without ownership the invariants... would not carry forward.' That is a dependence claim ('without X, Y fails'), not an inheritance claim (SRC_005 is a kind of / subsumes / carries forward the structure of SRC_003). The target thus mislabels the relation kind: the named kind and the stated relation do not match, so it fails the problem's requirement to name the kind and state what it is. The refutation clause is consistent with dependence, not inheritance, confirming the kind is misassigned.
